# Aunt Euphemia

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>; Aunty J.  <sub>[v3 c24 P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

She is small and elderly with a gently triangular face. She has big, tender blue eyes brimming with youthfulness, rose-colored cheeks, and silver-white hair arranged in small rolls above her ears.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is an outmoded, indulgent, and easygoing housemother who believes in letting young people manage themselves. She holds traditional views on decorum—particularly regarding the clergy—and maintains a youthful, laughing outlook on life. She is deeply forgiving, cheerful, and possesses a strong sense of personal faith.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c16 P64](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0064), [v3 c19 P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001), [v3 c25 P13](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0013), [v3 c35 P15](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0015), [v3 c37 P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042)_

## Traits

- Outmoded  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>
- Indulgent  <sub>[v3 c16 P64](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0064)</sub>
- Youthful at heart  <sub>[v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c19 P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001)</sub>
- Fear of snakes  <sub>[v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>

## Abilities

- Housekeeping  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Cooking instruction  <sub>[v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006)</sub>
- Knitting  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c25 P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- To visit her daughter's foreign mission field  <sub>[v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>

## History

Left alone in a large house after her daughter Elizabeth got married and left for missionary work, Aunt Euphemia agreed to move to Portmaris to keep house for Nell Harcourt, Honora, Mabel, and Cressy Lindsay at Tabby's Place. She brought along her two cats, Joseph and the Sarah-cat, and eventually adopted the stray cat Smudge into her household. She spent three winters managing Tabby's Place and caring for the college girls, staying behind during holiday breaks to look after the house and animals. Following the girls' graduation from Wexcombe, she took all three cats back to her own home. Later, despite her fear of snakes, she traveled to India to inspect her daughter's mission field.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 c16 P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065), [v3 c18 P0](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0000), [v3 c18 P1](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0001), [v3 c37 P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012), [v3 c38 P8](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0008), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her father James drowned at sea one month before her birth  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Named Jamesina after her late father  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Grew up in a family of about six girls  <sub>[v3 c19 P42](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0042)</sub>
- Was forbidden by her mother and husband to wear yellow silk  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>
- Her single daughter Elizabeth became a foreign missionary  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c36 P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> Remember, I am not claiming they are superior because of it. Indeed, I suppose they are likely much inferior. Nevertheless, they have proven quite comfortable through use.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> A yellow silk dress was something I perpetually desired, yet my mother initially, and later my husband, refused to countenance it. Obtaining a yellow silk dress is the absolute first action I intend to take upon arriving in heaven.  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>

> Once your soul is afflicted with rheumatism, you may as well proceed to select your coffin.  <sub>[v3 c25 P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)</sub>

> The four of you have been the sweetest, dearest, best girls who ever attended college as a group  <sub>[v3 c37 P13](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0013)</sub>

> Whoever possesses gumption understands its meaning, while whoever lacks it will remain perpetually ignorant of its meaning.  <sub>[v3 c37 P28](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0028)</sub>
